7.4.9 Receive Cancellation
[SWS_FrArTp_00224] ⌈If development error detection is enabled the function
FrArTp_CancelReceive shall check the validity of FrArTpRxSduId parameter.⌋
[SWS_FrArTp_00226] ⌈The FrArTp shall abort the reception of the current N-SDU if
the service FrArTp_CancelReceive provides a valid FrArTpRxSduId.⌋
[SWS_FrArTp_00227] ⌈The FrArTp shall reject the request for receive cancellation by
returning E_NOT_OK when
• the cancelled connection is not active, or when
• the FrArTp has already received the last frame of an unacknowledged connection,
or when
• the FrArTp has already provided the final AF of an acknowledged connection.
⌋
[SWS_FrArTp_00228] ⌈If the FrArTp_CancelReceive service has been success-
fully executed, the FrArTp shall call the PduR_FrArTpRxIndication with E_NOT_OK.⌋
